corrections.why: Both the register and Firelookout.com describe a wooden L-4 tower, so the record's kind should read tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Firelookout.com give a 10-foot wooden L-4 tower; WillhiteWeb gives a 21-foot tower with an L-4A cab. The record's 6.4 m (21 ft) is kept because WillhiteWeb gives the build history for it.
The register says removed in 1968, Firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968, and WillhiteWeb says disposed of by burning in November 1968. The story follows WillhiteWeb, which gives the detail.
Sources name three forests at different times: Crater National Forest built the tower in 1932, Rogue River National Forest controlled it in 1941, and the register lists Winema National Forest.

notes_for_editor: Height and fate conflict across sources; WillhiteWeb is the most detailed and is followed. Firelookout.org's Oregon list gives 42.63156, -121.55943 for FFLOS US 1011, but the register detail page gives 42.27931, -122.12129, which the record keeps; please check. The 'Limited views in 2022' caption on WillhiteWeb is not used because it does not say what remains. Current road or permit access is not described by any source, so access is unset; drive_up rests only on the WillhiteWeb header.
